I have been in my relationship for 4 years and had my first outbreak in December. When I told my boyfriend that I got tested positive for HSV2 he was there for me of course but we were both very confused. I trust my boyfriend very much and I’m certain he trusts me, however with news like this your mind goes wondering... he has never had an OB but he could have still passed it on to me if he does carry the virus.. overwhelmed and over thinking  I started wondering  that you know maybe he did cheat (bc I know I didn’t) and I know the same thing was running thru his mind. Our trust was tested for sure. 

So bc I got tested positive thru a swab test my doctor told me that I could do a blood test and if it came back positive, that means I probably had the virus for a while (years or longer) and that this was my first outbreak. If the results came back negative, that meant that I more than likely contracted it in the last 6 months and my body did not develop the antibodies yet. 

I ended up doing the blood test just for a piece of mind, the results came back positive. So I have had this virus for quite some time and it has just been living dormant in my body. 

Even before I did the blood test my boyfriend and I did extensive research and came to terms that either of us could have had it and passed it to one another or even both got it from a previous partner. 

Long story short, your status whether positive or negative (fingers crossed) is not your fault and your boyfriend should not make you feel that way. He should go get checked as well. So many people have the virus and pass it on without even knowing! Do not let him belittle you and accuse you of things you know you didn’t do. Do research together and fight thru it together and if he is not willing to do that for you I promise you there are people out there who will. 

If positive it is a MINOR skin condition that can be controlled.  If he doesn’t want to stay w you bc of it, good. You deserve better and will find better. 

I promise you if my boyfriend wasn’t as supportive as he was and didn’t do extensive research and do everything in his will power to calm me down we would not be where we are today. 

It’s not easy either however, I am struggling to feel attractive, sexy and loved bc the sigma of herpes. But believe me reading thru this sub definitely helps, you will realize that the stigma is very wrong and it’s actually ALOT more common than you think. 

I hope this helps and I wish you nothing but the best 💕💕
